description: Bootstrap inbox proof (SPEC §8.1.5): a device proves its bootstrap queue with a BIP-340 signature by its inbox key over SHA-256(utf8('oc-lock-chat/inbox-proof/v1:' || action || ':' || bootstrap_id || ':' || decimal(ts))), action 'drain' or 'ack'; an ack also appends ':' || hex(SHA-256(utf8(the sorted, distinct envelope ids joined by '\n'))). bootstrap_id is derived from inbox_pubkey per §8.1.2. Proves: the proof names its queue through the key alone, a drain proof is no ack proof, and a verifier at more than 600 s from ts refuses it.
notes: sig is BIP-340 with the given aux_rand, so it reproduces exactly; any valid BIP-340 signature over the digest is an equally valid proof. inbox_pubkey is the x-only public key of inbox_sk, lowercase hex. The operator checks inbox_pubkey and MUST NOT store it. The ack proof covers exactly the envelope ids of its request, so a proof seen once acknowledges nothing else.
